advance: Only propose a separately prospectively powered qualification if at least one edited endpoint has >=6/8 faster pairs AND >=1% geometric improvement, neither edited endpoint has >2% geometric slowdown, and all controls pass. Otherwise publish this as a bounded screen with all registered results. No draft from this screen.
analysis: For each helper and each endpoint report all eight pairwise times, per-arm medians, geometric mean of C/A, median paired percent improvement, count C faster and a two-sided, balance-respecting randomization P based on absolute mean log ratios. Condition on exactly two A-first and two C-first at each direction; 6 x 6 = 36 assignments. The 95% simultaneous inference is deferred to a prospective follow-up. Report immediate no-op and first-activation transitions distinctly.
eligibility_gates: Whole-command unscored physically traced before and after scoring for both directions, default Wild for every API Rust job, no native reports/fixed width or wrapper on either arm. Preserve compiler counts and real linker path.

Stock and candidate must have same registered artifact/diagnostic rosters, observable CLI and Rust caller, fresh repeated command, and independently verified emitted ELF contents. For physical full/full variability, retain every raw identity. The only pre-known classes eligible as stock variance are .rodata sh_entsize and the resulting GNU build-ID; require actual stock full/full recurrence across BOTH values before attributing an observed difference to this. All bytes outside them must be identical when claiming an equivalent same-source product.

Compare ordinary arm source changes, normal full and cached recipe on the same paths. Preserve cold-to-warm training and recovery counts. Nested actual linker input activation, invalid native input, removal/recovery, cfg activation and side outputs must match ordinary behavior.

Single host exclusive study lock, same CPU allocation and jobs, same image hashes/OS and storage, no external heavy job. Reject on missing result, wall/disk guard or behavioral failure. No outlier removal.
exclusions: No code change to Ruff. The separately preregistered, then correctness-rejected A9 three-arm/three-edit schedule remains unscored. This new Cargo-only mechanism tests the lowest-fanout semantic edit and the real parser edit with two affected tests; stdlib is reserved for independent validation and cannot be substituted.
measurement: One time.monotonic_ns interval around the ordinary cargo process per command, from inside pre-established identical mounts. 619 Cargo artifacts, 102 exes, 110 ELF products. Source transitions, CLI/real Rust caller and product verification happen outside this interval. Each pair starts with both arms on same previous source revision. New state persists across pairs; odd pairs reverse the complete patch, even restore. Following each pair run one identically ordered no-op per arm, timing reported separately. No strace inside a timed interval.
media: same dedicated ext4, independent physical targets and build stores, identical logical mount paths
purpose: Feasibility screen for replacing frontend and LLVM with real default rustc link-only on already-proved cfg-disabled workspace integration targets. Neither rustc nor GCC/Wild process count is expected to decline. This experiment alone cannot qualify a draft.
setup: Independent writable arm contexts copied from the same frozen, fully built, default 619-unit workspace. Seed, restore and genuine preflight source edit as needed; immediately verify all-fresh no-op after every edit. An independent cold and duplicate full stock reference precede confirmation if screen advances.
